summary: Hummel kit. Seafrigo on the front and ZEturf on the match shorts, per the club's announcements. SIM Agences d'emploi (front) and DF Industrie (sleeve) are cited from the club's partners page, which lists them as official partners but doesn't say where they sit on the shirt; no source names every placement, so the list isn't marked complete.
